scope: science-inspection, mobility-logistics, and climate-adaptation candidate packs
notes: This file defines review cases only; it is not evidence that images were generated or accepted.
Image/API generation and the final photo-visual-review/v1 artifact require a separately authorized run.

review_focus: specimen and scale are both legible
no decorative laboratory UI or readable labels
sample inlet and atmospheric context share one frame
weather affects visibility or material without becoming a generic mood overlay
origin, scanner handoff, and destination read in order
parcel spacing supports one conveyor cycle
machine-vision cues do not become a sci-fi interface
yard scale and safe service path remain visible
fixed erosion reference and waterline are comparable
restoration intervention remains visible without infographic text
shade and exposed pavement boundary is clear
thermal or sensor evidence has a physical reference
heat or airborne particles affect the full scene consistently
